title: ECL mission-contract profile v1
description: Inbound typed mission assignment for a bounded-authority worker (e.g. Gilgamesh, the generalist fallthrough), emitted by either a human or the orchestrator, wrapped by an ECL envelope. Validates the YAML frontmatter only; the richer body (if any) is owned by the receiving Eidolon's own repo and MUST be a strict subset of this profile. Fields mirror the nexus's delegation-contract shape {objective, scope, deliverables, evidence_required, stop_conditions} plus a capability-authority table (ESL change generalist-eidolon, Track E digest§5/§7).

eidolon.description: Only a human or the orchestrator may originate a mission-contract; a worker never mints one for itself.

objective.description: A single, bounded statement of the mission's goal.

paths.description: Repo-relative paths the worker MAY act within.

mode.description: Coarse scope-access mode. The fine-grained per-capability grant lives in `authority`.

deliverables.description: Named artifacts or outcomes the mission is expected to produce.

evidence_required.description: Externalized verification the worker MUST attach before claiming completion (never self-report, digest§4).

stop_conditions.description: Named conditions under which the bounded loop halts (budget exhaustion, authority boundary, deliverable complete, ...).

authority.description: The capability-authority table (default + escalation, digest§7). `write` grants a sandboxed/PROPOSE-only edit surface, never the real tree (security.writes_repo: false at the roster level); `deploy` MUST be false for any fallthrough-generalist worker (refuse-set, R-005).
